global: This miso ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu, crisp menma, and fresh green onions arranged atop. Served in a white bowl with red geometric trim, it rests on a bright, clean surface under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: The surface is smooth, light-colored, and slightly reflective, with soft shadows and gentle curves visible.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red geometric pattern and blue calligraphy along its rim.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green onions and pork, appears rich, golden-brown, and glossy in the bowl.
regions.spoon: White plastic spoon with smooth surface, slightly curved bowl, and textured grip area visible.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale brown, glossy, and slightly curved with visible fibrous texture and subtle surface striations.
